p: heard say: By the report of the spies. Nu 13:26.
goeth over before thee: To guide you and govern you.
righteousness the LORD hath brought me: Man by himself deserves nothing but God's anger, and if God spares anyone it comes from his great mercy.
stiffnecked people: Like stubborn oxen who will not endure their masters yoke.
from the day that thou didst: He proves by the length of time, that their rebellion was great and intolerable.
finger of God: That is, miraculously, and not by the hand of men.
corrupted themselves: As soon as man declines from the obedience of God, his ways are corrupt.
Let me alone: Demonstrating that the prayers of the faithful are a bar to restrain God's anger so that he does not consume all.
way which the LORD had commanded: That is, from the Law: in which he declares what the cause of our punishment is.
destroyed him: By which he shows the danger they are in who have authority and do not resist wickedness.
rebelled against the commandment of the: At the return of the spies.
forty days and forty nights: By which is signified that God requires earnest continuance in prayer.
Remember thy servants: The godly in their prayers ground on God's promise, and confess their sins.
